changes.detail: D-088 reconcile fix 2026-10-09 (PR #65 review): reserve() keeps cost_compared false on the allocation of a plan that does not compare cost (calibration, cost_basis not_compared, a not-compared canary), settle() records it too, and reconcile() of such an allocation keeps the reserved cost in the ledger, records the receipt's cost as reported_cost and judges overrun on tokens only; before, reconcile() wrote the receipt cost into the ledger and compared it with the cost ceiling 0, so the next reserve held META_PRIOR_OVERRUN
